summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for JUBLIA (efinaconazole, NDA203567). The Office/Division Director memo and Medical Review both state the application was not referred to an advisory committee because it raised no novel or complex scientific or regulatory issues, the drug has clinically insignificant systemic absorption and few adverse events, and FDA had ample experience with topical azole antifungals. With no AdComm meeting, there are no committee-driven changes to the approval.
